{"consolidated_memory":"## cli/commands/deploy.py: Hang on Exit (Two Separate Root Causes)

**File:** cli/commands/deploy.py (developer tooling side)
**Symptom:** Hang on exit in the deploy command—process finishes work but never returns
**Covering test:** tests/cli/test_deploy.py
**Repro:** Deploy the sample project and wait
**Stack:** Python

### Occasion 1: [2026-05-05]
**Root cause:** Floating point rounding in the money path
**Fix:** Moved the arithmetic to integer minor units
**PR:** #1229 on branch fix/hang-on-exit-1
**Result:** Flaky test went from 84 failures per hundred runs to zero

### Occasion 2: [2026-06-17]
**Root cause:** Mutable default argument shared across calls (affected clients still pinned to v1 SDK)
**Fix:** Made the default empty and built the value per call
**PR:** #3016 on branch fix/hang-on-exit-2
**Result:** Reclaimed 61 GB of blob storage

Both occasions manifested as the same symptom but had entirely different causes. The second occurrence was discovered 43 days after the first fix was deployed."}
